briefing.headline: Speed brain: Slow charts
good: Other brains: LOCK-IN spike wave: edge sentinel: 16 people-fetches in 15 min vs ~5.8 normal · hot: / 10 · Money brain: Checkout leak · Data brain: Over budget · Security brain: Headless flood · Content brain: Gaps · Fixer brain: Backlog · Traffic brain: Surge
watch: Admin: Chart pages: the slowest 10% of real loads take 6.37s — phones 2.54s vs desktop 15s (47% of loads on phones); the server answers in 0.18s and candles in 0.03s (HIT) — the time is on the visitor's side. Desktops are slower than phones, so it is not phone CPU — something desktop loads (more candles, panels, a far country) is the lead. A headless flood is on (CN: 159 raw vs ~5.9, 0 stayed, US: 126 raw vs ~9.4, 2 stayed, GB: 53 raw vs ~5.9, 1 stayed) — its loads pollute the desktop number; trust phones until it stops. Most slow-load time sits in: desktop/IN 31s ×43, mobile/IN 5.1s ×49, mobile/IR 23s ×10, mobile/US 0.48s ×248. Needs a build session to profile one slow load.
